name: zephyr
description: Zephyr CRM and project operations. The backend is .NET; these scripts are the project's check entry points.

scripts.typecheck: dotnet build src/backend/Zephyr.Api.Tests --no-incremental -warnaserror && node --check scripts/setup-env.mjs && node --check scripts/stack.test.mjs && node --check scripts/render-realms.mjs && node --check scripts/lint.mjs && node --check scripts/seed.mjs && node --check tools/search-benchmark/bench.mjs
scripts.lint: dotnet format whitespace src/backend/Zephyr.Api --verify-no-changes && dotnet format whitespace src/backend/Zephyr.Api.Tests --verify-no-changes && node scripts/lint.mjs && node --check tests/seeds.test.mjs && node --check tests/check.test.mjs && node --check tests/volume.test.mjs
scripts.build: dotnet build src/backend/Zephyr.Api -c Release -warnaserror && node --check scripts/render-realms.mjs
